description: This file is a Bash script used for automated performance benchmarking of an Android application. It includes setup for device connection, app installation, UI interactions, memory and CPU sampling, and execution of benchmark tests for screen and chat functionalities with detailed data collection and summarization.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help message with usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command-line tool is available, exits if missing.

methods.name: adb_cmd
methods.description: Executes adb command, optionally targeting specific device serial.

methods.name: dump_ui
methods.description: Captures the current UI layout in XML format.

methods.name: ui_has
methods.description: Checks whether a given pattern exists in the current UI.

methods.name: wait_for_pattern
methods.description: Waits until a specific UI pattern appears or attempts run out.

methods.name: ensure_connected
methods.description: Verifies that the app shows a 'Connected' status on the UI.

methods.name: ensure_screen_online
methods.description: Navigates to the screen view and confirms the WebView is active.

methods.name: ensure_chat_online
methods.description: Navigates to the chat view and verifies the chat input is visible.

methods.name: capture_mem
methods.description: Captures memory info for the app at current state.

methods.name: start_cpu_sampler
methods.description: Starts sampling CPU usage over a specified number of samples.

methods.name: summarize_cpu
methods.description: Computes and logs CPU usage statistics from sample data.

methods.name: summarize_mem
methods.description: Extracts and logs memory usage information.

methods.name: summarize_gfx
methods.description: Analyzes graphics rendering data for frame metrics and jankiness.

methods.name: measure_launch
methods.description: Measures the app launch time and connection time multiple times.

methods.name: run_screen_benchmark
methods.description: Performs the screen interaction benchmark, recording performance data.

methods.name: run_chat_benchmark
methods.description: Performs the chat interaction benchmark, recording performance data.
